symptom: Two migration tests hit Vitest's five-second default in CI after the SQL ladder reached 147 migrations. Both execute the full ladder before checking runtime ledger permissions or a populated setup upgrade.
rule: playbooks/ci-red.md: reproduce with controlled database transit delay, then reuse the existing 30-second per-case ladder budget only for the failing cases. Retain every SQL migration, permission denial, backfill and lease-fence assertion. The timing scenario requires TEST_DATABASE_URL to point at a disposable PostgreSQL through a loopback proxy adding 10 ms per client-to-server chunk, with original and fixed test sources run separately. An idle local pass is not a reproduced timeout. A replay overlay would copy the fixed test budget onto the parent and cannot prove this test-only regression.
check: pnpm --dir apps/control-plane exec vitest run src/migrations.test.ts -t 'lets the runtime verify but never rewrite the migration ledger|backfills immutable setup inputs and safely requeues pre-lease running work'
